name: tpl-existence-1-goal~p2
task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) captures acquiring the key before reaching the goal, but the task says “Grab the key first,” which also commands acquiring it. Since at_goal is only true on the terminal step, the order clause with Existence(at_goal) forces has_key before the goal but does not require the key to be acquired first; the candidate accepts reaching the goal without ever acquiring it. Add a hard Existence(has_key).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard Existence(at_goal) requires the goal, and hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) requires acquiring the key first.

texts: Acquire the key before reaching the goal.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
